title: YesStyle on Trustpilot: score, complaints and what the numbers show
seoTitle: YesStyle Trustpilot reviews: score and complaints
description: YesStyle’s Trustpilot score on October 28, 2026: a TrustScore of 4.4 from 104,552 reviews, 71% five stars, complaints concentrated on international delivery, and why the score says nothing about your country.
metaDescription: YesStyle on Trustpilot on October 28, 2026: 4.4 from 104,000+ reviews, 71% five stars, complaints about delivery and tracking. What the score does not show.
imageAlt: YesStyle logo and five stars filled up to the 4.4 Trustpilot score, read on October 28, 2026

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: YesStyle has a good Trustpilot score, with one caveat. On October 28, 2026, the TrustScore was 4.4 from more than 104,000 reviews, 71% of them five stars, and the complaints center on international delivery and tracking. The score is global and does not separate countries, so it says nothing about delivery to your address.

contentSections.heading: What the score measures
paragraphs: The TrustScore is the profile’s rating on Trustpilot. On October 28, 2026, YesStyle had a 4.4, labeled “Excellent”, from 104,552 reviews; 11,757 of them were posted in the last 12 months. The profile is claimed by the company and has a paid Trustpilot subscription, as the page itself states.

The breakdown by star, in the same reading: 71% five stars, 18% four, 3% three, 1% two and 7% one. Five and four stars make up most of the total; the one-star share, at 7%, weighs more than two and three stars combined, and that is where the complaints appear.

image.alt: Bars from five stars to one with the distribution of YesStyle’s Trustpilot reviews: 71%, 18%, 3%, 1% and 7%
image.caption: Distribution of YesStyle’s Trustpilot reviews, read on October 28, 2026. Our chart.

postParagraphs: The average sums all of that up in one number. To decide, it is worth looking at what the low ratings say and how the store answers them; that is what comes next.

contentSections.heading: Who reviews, and from where
paragraphs: The profile we read, for www.yesstyle.com, is global: it does not separate reviews by country, and the page does not say how many came from any one place. The score mixes buyers from different countries, with different shipping costs, delivery times and customs.

That changes how to read it: the score says how the store performs overall, not what delivery is like to your address. That information is at checkout and in the store’s shipping table, not on Trustpilot.
Who runs the store and where it is based are covered in [Is YesStyle legit?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review).

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the complaints
paragraphs: We read the negative reviews visible on the profile on October 28, 2026 and noted the themes, without counting or ranking them. They revolve around international delivery:
bullets: Delayed delivery and a long wait, for a package shipped from abroad.
Order held in processing, before shipping.

image.alt: Illustration of a tracking screen: parcel shipped, flight done, delivery stalled and the house still waiting, next to a receipt with a barcode and a globe
image.caption: Our illustration of a stalled tracking page, one of the complaint themes. Keep the order number and the tracking number.

postParagraphs: These are the points where an international purchase usually fails. For the reader, they say where to look: the delivery time at checkout, the tracking after dispatch and the packaging on arrival.

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the praise
paragraphs: In the positive reviews, in the same reading, the themes are different:
bullets: Delivery that sometimes arrives ahead of schedule.
App and website that are easy to use.
postParagraphs: Praise and complaints speak of different moments of the purchase: the praise, of the catalog, the price and the package that arrived; the complaint, of the package that was late or never came. The score puts the two together.

contentSections.heading: What the store replies
paragraphs: According to the profile, read on October 28, 2026, YesStyle replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and the page notes that replies may use artificial intelligence.

Replying is not resolving. We did not read the text of the replies, so this article does not say whether they solve the problem for the person who complained. Before buying, open a few one-star reviews on the profile and read the store’s reply under each one, especially those about tracking and lost packages.

contentSections.heading: What cannot be concluded
paragraphs: The score answers one question, not all of them. Four things the reading of October 28, 2026 does not support:
bullets: That the score applies to your country: the profile is global and does not separate reviews by origin.
That the score measures the product: it combines product, delivery and customer service in a single rating, and the complaint themes we read are about delivery and order processing.
That the store resolves complaints: the profile shows the response rate, 98%, and how fast the replies come; the text of the replies was not read.
What Trustpilot’s AI summary says: the page shows a summary generated by artificial intelligence, and this article does not use it as a source.

contentSections.heading: Our check
paragraphs: On October 28, 2026, we read YesStyle’s public Trustpilot profile, without logging in: the score, the number of reviews, the distribution by star, the response rate and the visible reviews, which is where the themes came from.
In the store’s app, in a test of our own without a purchase, we checked the checkout: it has a field for the reward code.
Nobody at the site bought from YesStyle for this article. Trustpilot’s numbers change every month; check the profile on the day you buy.

contentSections.heading: Can you trust YesStyle going by Trustpilot?
paragraphs: Going by Trustpilot, the reading is good: on October 28, 2026, a TrustScore of 4.4, “Excellent”, from 104,552 reviews, 71% of them five stars and 7% one star, with 98% of negative reviews answered, usually within 24 hours.

The caveat is about scope, not the score. The profile is global, does not separate countries, and the complaints we read are about international delivery: delays, tracking and lost packages. Trustpilot shows how the store performs overall; the shipping cost and delivery time for your address are at checkout.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: The complaints center on delivery, so what you check before paying is the shipping cost and the delivery time for your country, which appear at checkout. For the US, the UK, Canada and Australia, delivery times, shipping costs and customs are in our [YesStyle shipping guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).
After paying, keep the order number and the tracking code: they are what you need to open a ticket with customer service if the package is late or the tracking stops.

If you have decided to buy, the [YesStyle page](/en/coupons/yesstyle) on this site takes you to the store. The link is an affiliate link: the purchase may earn a commission for Em Casa com Cecília, at no extra cost to you.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does YesStyle have a good Trustpilot score? On October 28, 2026, the TrustScore was 4.4, labeled “Excellent”, from 104,552 reviews; 71% gave five stars and 7% gave one.

What are the most common complaints about YesStyle? In the negative reviews read on October 28, 2026, the themes are about international delivery: delays and long waits, tracking that stops, lost packages, damaged items and orders held in processing.

Does YesStyle reply to negative reviews? According to the Trustpilot profile, read on October 28, 2026, the store replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and the replies may use artificial intelligence.
Does YesStyle ship to my country? The Trustpilot score does not say. The shipping cost and delivery time for each country are in the store’s shipping table and at checkout.
